_comment: RunPod Serverless endpoint definition for AMALIA-9B-0626-DPO on the official vLLM worker. Create the endpoint in the RunPod console (Serverless → New Endpoint → vLLM quick deploy) or via the GraphQL API using these values.
name: amalia-9b-dpo

networkVolume.purpose: Hugging Face cache so a fresh worker does not re-download the 18 GB bf16 weights.

notes: bf16 weights are 18.3 GB; a 24 GB card leaves too little KV cache at MAX_MODEL_LEN 8192, so the 48 GB tier is the default (A40 $1.22/h flex is the cheapest).
For a 24 GB tier (L4 $0.69/h) run the AWQ int4 spike first: QUANTIZATION=awq with a quantised checkpoint, and confirm the editor golden set does not regress.
The ChatML chat template is embedded in the tokenizer; no CUSTOM_CHAT_TEMPLATE needed.
Keep workersMin at 1 during business hours in production for predictable latency; leave 0 for the MVP.
